C0060.title: Hubei Xiangyang Reports Qiai 'Wellness Cigarettes' for Suspected False Advertising
C0060.summary: Authorities in Xiangyang, Hubei, reported that Qiai “wellness cigarettes” were suspected of illegal advertising and related violations. Public information confirms suspected illegal advertising and false promotion, while specific promotional claims, penalty decisions, and follow-up enforcement results should be verified against further disclosures from market regulators.
